# RAINCLOUD

> RAINCLOUD sells one engagement: a 100-point GTM audit, a 90-day rebuild of the go-to-market motion on a fee that steps down every month, and ongoing advisory while the client's own team runs it. Run personally by Colin Dowling.

RAINCLOUD is run by Colin Dowling: 3x VP of Sales · 2x founder · Host, Modern Business Life. VP Global Enterprise Sales at GoDaddy, SVP Revenue at Alembic (Seed to $145M Series B), VP Channel Sales at Liquid Web, Enterprise Sales Director at WP Engine. Colin runs every engagement personally. There is no delivery team, no junior analyst, and no offshore bench. Two builds at a time, with a small number of advisory clients alongside them.

## The engagement

1. The 100-Point GTM Framework. Free. Every point the audit scores, published in full.
2. The 100-Point GTM Audit. $5,000, 10 business days. All 100 points across ten sections, each scored met or not met (one point each, 100 total), against the client's CRM data and four to six interviews; a signed baseline; every finding, ranked by what it costs in pipeline, each quantified; the fix sequence; a one-page business case; a 45-minute readout. Required before any engagement. Not credited toward the build. No refund.
3. The 90-Day GTM Fix. $37,500, billed $15,000 (month 1, diagnose and rebuild), $12,500 (month 2, install), $10,000 (month 3, prove and hand off). The outbound architecture installed in month 2 uses four components: Hunter, Harvester, Farmer and Shepherd.
4. Ongoing. Advisory at $7,500 per month from month four (monthly operating review, monthly work session, weekly office hours, quarterly re-score of all 100 points). Or the GTM Scorecard at $4,000 per month, billed quarterly: measurement and direction only, available from month seven or directly after an audit.

Terms: six-month minimum from engagement start (three months of build, three of advisory), cancel any time after. No money-back guarantee; the audit is the risk reversal. Nothing is sold before the audit.

## Who it is for

B2B companies between $50M and $200M in revenue, with a sales team that works out of a CRM (HubSpot, Salesforce, Pipedrive or comparable), selling through outbound or inbound email and phone conversations, missing a number they have already committed to, with one executive who will own the work for six months. Below the range is sometimes a fit; above it there is usually an internal team.

## Results

- AgentPress: 7 to 25 qualified meetings a month in 45 days.
- 1905 New Media: digital services from $4M to $11M over two years.

## What RAINCLOUD is not

Not a SaaS product, not a dashboard or seat-based software vendor, not an agency, and not an open-ended hourly engagement. Earlier versions of this site described a "4D Sales Intelligence" offering, a "Trident" architecture, and separate offers for demand generation, content, AI readiness and AI agents. All are retired here. RAINCLOUD sells one engagement: a 100-point GTM audit, a 90-day rebuild on a declining fee, and ongoing advisory. Colin's other ventures are separate sites: Ants (managed AI agents, withants.com), Ghostwriter (B2B content, friendlyghostwriter.com) and The AI Ready Advisor (executive AI strategy).
